integrity: The all-horizon five-visit classification is proved by a positive even-spin expansion, strict convexity, symmetry, and a cubic root. Exact rational tests are corroborative and do not certify claims beyond the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for independent, identically sensitive detection conditional on stationary symmetric two-state availability; fixed endpoints, no false positives, nonadaptive surveys. No demonstrated ecological field applicability, nonlinear state responses or general all-horizon formula for other visit counts. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A parity law for short-window ecological surveys and an exact five-visit clustering threshold
